构建进行中，等待日志输出。: Build in progress. Waiting for log output.
构建成功后将在此展示。: The artifact will appear here after a successful build.
此构建没有可用制品。: This build has no available artifact.
环境配置已改变，请关闭后重新创建并核对配置。: Environment configuration changed. Close this dialog and create the version again after reviewing the configuration.
固定此构建与下方环境配置，留待稍后部署。创建不会改变线上流量，也不会生成访问地址: Freeze this build and the environment configuration below for deployment later. Creating a version does not change live traffic or generate a URL.
已固定 Secret 版本引用，值不可读取。: Secret version references are frozen. Values cannot be read back.
版本固定代码与创建时的环境配置。待部署版本不会改变线上流量；选择“部署此版本”后: Versions freeze code and environment configuration at creation. Undeployed versions do not change live traffic. Select Deploy this version to start a deployment.
需要提前准备版本时，在“构建与发布”的更多操作中选择“创建待部署版本”。: To prepare a version ahead of time, choose Create undeployed version from the more actions menu under Build & deploy.
此环境还没有版本。可以直接发布成功构建，或先创建待部署版本。: This environment has no versions yet. Deploy a successful build directly or create an undeployed version first.
待部署版本已创建，线上部署未改变。: Undeployed version created. The live deployment is unchanged.
尚无部署记录。固定地址在部署验证通过并提交后生成。: No deployments yet. A pinned URL is generated after deployment validation and commit.
将使用此版本创建时冻结的代码和配置，替换目标环境的当前部署。之后对环境配置的修改: Replace the current deployment in the target environment with the code and configuration frozen in this version. Later environment configuration changes are not included.
版本标签或说明过长，请缩短后重试。: The version tag or message is too long. Shorten it and try again.
当前部署已改变，请关闭后重新核对再部署。: The current deployment changed. Close this dialog and review it again before deploying.
当前版本使用的对象存储绑定: Object storage bindings in the current version
对象存储绑定名称须为 1–64 位字母、数字或下划线，以字母或下划线开头，不能使: Object storage binding names must be 1–64 letters, digits or underscores, start with a letter or underscore, and must not start with KRUN_.
对象存储绑定名称重复，或与变量、Secret、版本元数据冲突。: Object storage binding names must be unique and must not conflict with variables, Secrets or version metadata.
请为每个对象存储绑定选择一个桶。: Select a bucket for each object storage binding.
桶已创建，可在 Worker 环境中添加对象存储绑定。: Bucket created. Add an object storage binding in a Worker environment to use it.
管理存储桶，并在 Worker 中通过对象存储绑定使用。: Manage storage buckets and use them in Workers through object storage bindings.
同名对象将被覆盖；上传会保留 Worker 读取对象所需的元数据。: Objects with the same name will be overwritten. Uploads preserve the metadata required for Workers to read them.
缺少读取元数据，Worker 无法通过对象存储绑定读取此对象。: Required metadata is missing. Workers cannot read this object through an object storage binding.
新建 Preview 时，复制这里的环境变量、Secrets 和对象存储绑定。各: New Previews copy the environment variables, Secrets and object storage bindings here. Save each section separately. Existing Previews and production are unaffected.
选择本组织的桶，代码通过 env.绑定名称 访问。保存后仅影响新建 Previe: Select a bucket in this organization and access it as env.BINDING_NAME. Saving only affects new Previews.
用于 API Token、密码等敏感信息，代码通过 env.名称 读取。值加密存: Use for API tokens, passwords and other sensitive values, accessed as env.NAME. Values are encrypted and cannot be viewed after saving; you can replace or delete them.
仅影响之后新建的 Preview，已有 Preview 和生产环境保持不变。: Only affects Previews created afterwards. Existing Previews and production stay unchanged.
保存或删除后会自动发布新版本，无需重新构建代码。: Saving or deleting automatically deploys a new version without rebuilding code.
保存后在首次部署时生效。: Saved values take effect with the first deployment.
此名称已存在，请使用该行的“替换”按钮。: This name already exists. Use Replace on its row.
旧值不会回填。请输入新值，保存后替换旧值。: The old value is never displayed. Enter a new value to replace it when saved.
删除后，代码将无法从此配置读取该 Secret。: After deletion, code cannot read this Secret from this configuration.
变量名须为有效的 JavaScript 标识符，且不能使用 KRUN_ 前缀。: Variable names must be valid JavaScript identifiers and must not start with KRUN_.
变量 {{name}} 的值不是有效的 JSON。: The value of variable {{name}} is not valid JSON.
给 Worker 代码使用的普通配置，例如 API_URL。代码通过 env.A: Ordinary configuration for Worker code, such as API_URL, accessed as env.API_URL. Put passwords and tokens in Secrets.
高级设置：在代码中读取版本信息: Advanced: Read version information in code
可选。设置一个变量名，Worker 就能读取当前版本的 ID、标签和创建时间；不: Optional. Set a variable name so Worker code can read the current version ID, tag and creation time. Leave empty if unused.
For example, enter VERSION_INFO and read the version ID as env.VERSION_INFO.id. Enter a name here, rather than a version number.
重新加载会丢弃此页尚未保存的修改。: Reloading discards unsaved changes on this page.
保存后在下一次发布时生效，不会修改正在运行的版本。: Saved changes take effect on the next deployment. The running version is unaffected.
尚无已确认生效的版本: No version has been confirmed as effective
搜索版本 ID、标签、说明或保存者: Search version ID, tag, message or author
搜索部署 ID、版本 ID 或状态: Search deployment ID, version ID or state
查看保存者、保存时间、来源构建与此版本冻结的配置。: View the author, save time, source build and frozen configuration for this version.
部署成功，运行副本已确认生效。: Deployment succeeded. Runtime replicas have confirmed it is effective.
部署失败，请查看下方错误详情。: Deployment failed. See the error details below.
此部署已被后续部署替换。: This deployment was replaced by a later deployment.
部署已提交，正在等待运行副本确认生效。: Deployment committed. Waiting for runtime replicas to confirm it is effective.
部署请求已受理，正在排队或验证，请等待生效。: Deployment accepted. It is queued or being validated; waiting for it to take effect.
草稿用于下次从构建发布；可先编辑，再从草稿保存一个命名配置版本。: The draft is used for the next deployment from a build. Edit it here, then save it as a named configuration.
配置版本已进入发布队列，等待运行时确认后生效。: Configuration deployment queued. It becomes active after runtime confirmation.
配置保存后需发布才会运行。: Publish a saved configuration to start running it.
发布正在进行，当前生效标记将在运行时确认后更新。: Deployment in progress. The active marker updates after runtime confirmation.
配置可命名、复制和恢复；未生效历史保留 30 天，当前及发布中的配置继续保留。: Name, copy, or restore configurations. Inactive history is retained for 30 days; active and pending configurations remain available.
尚无独立配置版本。可以从环境草稿或当前生效配置保存第一份。: No saved configurations yet. Save your first one from the environment draft or active configuration.
请先完成一次代码构建，再将此配置用于首次部署。: Complete a code build before using this configuration for the first deployment.
配置版本已保存，当前运行未改变。: Configuration saved. The running deployment is unchanged.
使用所选配置生成新的发布版本。复用当前代码，部署成功后切换；旧配置与旧发布记录保: Create a release with the selected configuration and reuse the current code. Switch after deployment succeeds; keep previous configurations and releases.
部署或环境草稿已改变，请关闭确认框后重新核对。: The deployment or environment draft changed. Close this dialog and review again.
配置名称必填且最多 100 字节，说明最多 1000 字节。: A configuration name is required (up to 100 bytes). The description allows up to 1000 bytes.
配置独立保存，不会改变当前运行。发布成功后才切换生效。: Save configurations independently. The running deployment changes only after a successful deployment.
例如：XXX 测试、支付联调、正式基线: For example: checkout test, payment integration, production baseline
Secret 变更暂存在本次编辑中，保存配置后加密入库，发布成功后生效。: Secret changes stay in this editor until the configuration is saved. They are encrypted on save and take effect after deployment succeeds.
高亮显示普通配置差异；Secrets 使用保存时的固定引用，不展示值或逐值比较。: Highlighted rows show configuration changes. Secrets use frozen references; their values and value comparisons are never displayed.
新建预览默认配置已保存，仅影响之后新建的预览。: Defaults saved. Only subsequently created Previews are affected.
生产环境和预览环境统一管理，各自使用独立的配置与发布记录。: Manage production and Preview environments together, each with independent configuration and deployments.
管理当前账号的 GitHub 和 GitLab 仓库授权。: Manage GitHub and GitLab repository access for your account.
请联系管理员启用仓库账号授权。: Ask an administrator to enable repository authorization.
请确认你的 GitHub 账号能访问该仓库，并且仓库已开放给 GitHub Ap: Check that your GitHub account can access the repository and that the GitHub App has access to it. An administrator may need to grant access for organization repositories.
安装 GitHub App 或调整仓库范围: Install GitHub App or change repository access
使用此授权的 Worker 将无法发起新的仓库构建，直至重新授权。: New repository builds using this authorization will require you to reconnect.
保存后，有构建权限的成员可以通过此授权构建该 Worker 的绑定仓库。: Members with build permission can use this authorization to build the repository bound to this Worker.
仅显示当前账号可用的仓库。: Only repositories available to your account are shown.
没有可用仓库，请检查 Git 平台授权范围。: No repositories are available. Check the access granted on the Git platform.
当前绑定的仓库授权已失效。请由授权人重新授权，或使用你的授权重新绑定仓库。: The bound repository authorization is no longer valid. Ask the account owner to reauthorize, or bind the repository using your own authorization.
查看所有组织的对象存储桶。: Browse object storage buckets across all organizations.
搜索名称、前缀、ID 或组织: Search names, prefixes, IDs, or organizations
资源不存在或无权访问。: Resource not found or access denied.
查看当前控制面加载的配置。凭据、内部地址、服务名和标签原文已隐藏。: View the configuration loaded by this control plane. Credentials, internal addresses, service names, and raw labels are hidden.
当前控制面没有加载 Workers 运行配置。: This control plane has no Workers runtime configuration loaded.
使用业务池的运行实例: Use a serving runtime in the workload pool
由 krun 保管 PostgreSQL 源库凭据，为 Worker 提供数据库: Manage PostgreSQL origin credentials and database bindings for Workers.
创建后可将数据库绑定到 Worker。: Create a configuration to bind a database to a Worker.
删除后，使用此配置的 Worker 无法再建立新的数据库连接。: Workers using this configuration will no longer be able to open new database connections.
源库密码由平台保管，Worker 只获得代理接入凭据。: The platform stores the origin password. Workers receive proxy credentials.
Hyperdrive 绑定名称和配置不能为空，且名称不能重复。: Hyperdrive binding names and configurations are required and must be unique.
